sources.title: LCO Developer API
sources.support: Requests have states, windows and configurations; exposure_count can exceed one. Frame metadata links request_id/observation_id and related/versioned products. Authenticated endpoints require tokens.
sources.limitation: Examples do not prove complete accessible roster/history or per-exposure planned starts. No authenticated endpoint queried.

sources.title: LCO Data Archive
sources.locator: Science Data Archive; Raw and Quicklook Data
sources.support: Raw data, master calibrations and processed products are described. Science data normally have a one-year proprietary period; educational data are public.
sources.limitation: No programme, actual date range, raw completeness or rights for request logs verified.

sources.title: LCO Network Capabilities
sources.support: Dynamic scheduling can reassign requests to resources and respond to weather closures.
sources.limitation: A final resource/start cannot stand in for the predecision planned site/start.

sources.title: LCO BANZAI pipeline
sources.support: Processing records parameters/software versions. Products include SCI, BPM, ERR and CAT; source catalogues include FLUX and FLUXERR.
sources.limitation: Generic pipeline products are not qualified task outcomes; error semantics and target measurement require demonstration.

sources.title: LCO FITS headers
sources.support: REQNUM tracks a sub-request; L1FWHM is a frame source-summary measure in arcseconds. L1 fields belong to processed frames.
sources.limitation: Not a guaranteed one-exposure key or target PSF; no actual header or measurement acquired.

sources.title: LCO Acknowledgments
sources.support: States CC BY-NC 4.0 for scientific/educational images/data, subject to proprietary restrictions and attribution.
sources.limitation: Disagrees in version with S07; applicability to selected data and non-image records remains unresolved.

sources.title: LCO Terms of Service
sources.support: States CC BY-NC 2.0, proprietary restrictions, attribution and header preservation.
sources.limitation: Disagrees in version with S06; no choice of applicable licence or blanket roster/log redistribution permission inferred.

sources.title: ESO Data Access Policy
sources.support: Raw data and calibrations are archived; headers normally public immediately, with exceptions. Data distributed CC BY 4.0; retain headers and provenance attribution. Proprietary protection applies.
sources.limitation: No selected programme access, release of private operational records or cohort completeness demonstrated.

sources.title: ESO programmatic access
sources.locator: Query a TAP Service; Learn dataset actions
sources.support: Documents TAP/ADQL and dataset actions, with raw/reduced examples.
sources.limitation: Interactive documentation is not a retrieved raw schema or successful dataset join.

sources.title: ESO Archive FAQ: programmatic access
sources.locator: Standard VO protocols; current supported methods
sources.support: Documents TAP raw/reduced/ambient metadata, DataLink calibrations/provenance and token access. Older unlisted scripts deprecated after July 2026.
sources.limitation: No unverified historical download recipe is prescribed; concrete schema/version must be pinned in intake.

sources.title: ESO observation-quality FAQ
sources.support: Associated night logs accompany requested science frames and describe issues and ambient conditions.
sources.limitation: Delivered-frame-associated logs do not establish a complete planned exposure roster.

sources.title: ESO QC0 OB grading
sources.support: Grades compare measured conditions with programme constraints and aggregate parameter grades.
sources.limitation: Not M68 target-level delivery/SNR/FWHM labels, and not a qualified threshold source.

sources.title: Open-Meteo Historical Forecast API
sources.support: Early hours from successive runs are stitched into a continuous hourly series.
sources.limitation: Excluded as fixed-decision predictor under unchanged M68; not original full-run capture evidence.

sources.title: Open-Meteo Single Runs API
sources.locator: Introduction; Data availability; API endpoint and run parameter
sources.support: run selects initialization and full horizon. Provider lists ECMWF IFS HRES from 2024-03-14 and most other models from 2026-04-02.
sources.limitation: Availability dates are not audited completeness. Later retrieval does not prove capture at historical decision; model/version and fields unqualified.

sources.title: Open-Meteo GFS & HRRR API
sources.locator: Variable Per Model Availability; Hourly Parameter Definition
sources.support: Field support differs by product; GFS probability is calculated, and some high-resolution fields use other resolution products. Precipitation and gusts have interval semantics.
sources.limitation: Seven fields in a generic selector do not qualify a single model/run. Exact product version, contributing lineage and returned units require future evidence.

sources.title: Open-Meteo Terms
sources.support: API data use CC BY 4.0; free service is restricted to noncommercial use and request limits.
sources.limitation: Data licence and hosted service access are distinct; selected access mode and attribution not yet established.

failed_retrievals.inference: No schema or data completeness claim; this is not proof the provider endpoint is unavailable.
